name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I want to open with the honest version of my fit for this role. I don't have hands-on experience reading HAR files, network traces, or configuring SSO/SAML, and I'd rather tell you that directly than have it surface in a screen. What I do have is fifteen years of being the person who translates a technical system for whoever's in front of me, and real, current experience building the kind of technical product Yoodli is: AI systems that have to work reliably and be explainable to people who didn't build them.

At Solenzo, I build and troubleshoot AI agent architectures, translating loosely-formed business intent into precise, structured instructions, then own the CRM and integration infrastructure that keeps client data flowing correctly across systems. At Accelo, I owned client onboarding and API integrations directly, and escalated technical risk to leadership before it became an account problem, not after. At Birdeye, I was the bridge between customers and our Product and Engineering teams, translating what customers actually needed into feedback engineering could use.

What draws me to this role specifically is the AI angle. I'm not asking to be excited about AI coaching, I already am, it's the product category I build in every day. I'd come into the SSO/API debugging depth as a real gap to close, not a box already checked, but I close technical gaps quickly, that pattern is the one constant across every role in my career. I'd welcome the conversation.
